title: Theatre
about: Theatre companies, their artists and productions, venues and stages, performances, patrons who book and rate them, and artists who mentor one another.

title: Theatre (small)
about: The Theatre schema with a handful of rows in each table, small enough to trace a query by hand.

title: Theatre (large)
about: The Theatre schema with thousands of rows (6000 patrons, 2400 performances, 45000 bookings), where indexes and join algorithms make a difference.

title: Credit union
about: Members with share and loan accounts, debit cards, merchants and card payments, and six months of transfers between accounts, for transactions.

title: Software studio
about: Teams, engineers who report to managers, products, who works on what for how many hours, a weekly on-call rota, and releases.

title: Library
about: Books and their authors, copies, members, loans with due dates, and reservations.

title: Airline
about: Airports, aircraft and their seats, daily flights between hubs and spokes, passengers and a week of bookings.

title: Shop
about: A tree of categories, products with jsonb attributes and tags, customers, orders, payments and reviews.

title: Sensors
about: Sensors at four sites and three days of readings every 15 minutes, for window functions over a time series.
